title: Minimalist header — legibility without a veil

steps.path: Header over light and dark wallpaper
steps.headline: Clearer controls and status dots, with more wallpaper through the selected session.
steps.changed: Header glyphs use each theme's foreground with a subtle local halo. Session dots keep their status colours and gain a small contrast rim; idle dots are less faded. The selected session's surface is now 26% opaque instead of solid.
steps.notice: No full-width header veil or button fill was added. Content chips and message box are unchanged; other chrome styles retain their previous styling. Review both Meadow Mist and Midnight.
